description: Golden questions for text-to-SQL. Each carries a hand-written reference query; grading compares executed results, not query text, because there are many correct ways to write each of these.

questions.question: What was the Kansas City Chiefs' pass rate on designed plays in the 2023 season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2023 AND posteam = 'KC' AND is_designed_play

questions.question: Which team had the highest neutral-script pass rate in 2022?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2022 AND is_designed_play AND is_neutral_script GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(is_pass_call::INT) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the league average EPA per play on third and long since 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(epa) AS epa_per_play FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season >= 2020 AND down = 3 AND distance_bucket IN ('long', 'very_long') AND is_designed_play

questions.question: How many drives reached the red zone and ended in a touchdown in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2023 AND end_yardline_100 <= 20 AND scored_touchdown

questions.question: What was the coldest game on record in this data, and what was the temperature?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT game_id, temp FROM games WHERE temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY temp ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which passer had the best EPA per play in the 2021 season, with at least 300 plays?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2021 AND role = 'passer' GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING sum(plays) >= 300 ORDER BY sum(epa_per_play * plays) / sum(plays) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fourth-down attempts were there in each season from 2019 to 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT season, count(*) AS attempts FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND down = 4 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

questions.question: What share of designed plays were run out of shotgun in 2024?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(shotgun::INT) AS shotgun_rate FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2024 AND is_designed_play

questions.question: What fraction of regular season games did the home team win in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg((home_margin > 0)::INT) AS home_win_rate FROM games WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG'

questions.question: Rank the top five teams by offensive EPA per play in 2023.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2023 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(epa) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many designed plays did the San Diego Chargers run in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2013 AND posteam = 'LAC' AND is_designed_play

questions.question: How many rushing plays did the Ravens call in 2023, excluding quarterback kneels?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2023 AND posteam = 'BAL' AND is_designed_play AND NOT is_pass_call

questions.question: What is the pass rate inside the two-minute warning compared to the rest of the game, across all seasons?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT is_two_minute, avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE is_designed_play GROUP BY is_two_minute ORDER BY is_two_minute

questions.question: What was the largest margin of victory in any game in the data?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT max(abs(home_margin)) AS margin FROM games

questions.question: How many catches did Davante Adams have in 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(completions) AS receptions FROM player_game WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'receiver' AND player_name = 'D.Adams'

questions.question: How many times was Travis Kelce targeted in 2022?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(plays) AS targets FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'receiver' AND player_name = 'T.Kelce'

questions.question: Who did the Patriots play in week 1 of the 2016 season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN home_team = 'NE' THEN away_team ELSE home_team END AS opponent FROM games WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2016 AND week = 1 AND 'NE' IN (home_team, away_team)

questions.question: How many total points were scored when the Chiefs played the Rams in 2018?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT total_points FROM games WHERE season_type = 'REG' AND season = 2018 AND 'KC' IN (home_team, away_team) AND 'LA' IN (home_team, away_team)

questions.question: How many touchdown passes did Peyton Manning throw in 2004?
How many passing yards did Patrick Mahomes have in the 2022 playoffs?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(yards) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'POST' AND role = 'passer' AND player_name = 'P.Mahomes'

questions.question: Who won the 2016 divisional round game between the Steelers and the Chiefs?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN home_margin > 0 THEN home_team ELSE away_team END AS winner FROM games WHERE season = 2016 AND playoff_round = 'divisional' AND 'PIT' IN (home_team, away_team) AND 'KC' IN (home_team, away_team)

questions.question: How many total points were scored in Super Bowl LIII?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT total_points FROM games WHERE season = 2018 AND playoff_round = 'super_bowl'

questions.question: How many touchdown passes did Tom Brady throw in the 2020 playoffs?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(touchdowns) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'POST' AND role = 'passer' AND player_name = 'T.Brady'

questions.question: How many playoff games did the Chiefs win from 2018 through 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM games WHERE season BETWEEN 2018 AND 2023 AND season_type = 'POST' AND ((home_team = 'KC' AND home_margin > 0) OR (away_team = 'KC' AND home_margin < 0))

questions.question: How many Chiefs drives ended in a touchdown in the 2022 playoffs?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'POST' AND posteam = 'KC' AND scored_touchdown

questions.question: How many games did the Patriots win in 2010?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM games WHERE season = 2010 AND season_type = 'REG' AND ((home_team = 'NE' AND home_margin > 0) OR (away_team = 'NE' AND home_margin < 0))

questions.question: How many rushing yards did Derrick Henry have in 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(yards) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'rusher' AND player_name = 'D.Henry'

questions.question: Which team had the highest payroll in 2023?
Which Super Bowls did the Detroit Lions play in?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT season FROM games WHERE playoff_round = 'super_bowl' AND 'DET' IN (home_team, away_team)

questions.question: How many rushing touchdowns did Tom Brady have in the 2023 season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(touchdowns) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'rusher' AND player_name = 'T.Brady'

questions.question: Who did the Cleveland Browns play in the 2015 playoffs?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT game_id FROM games WHERE season = 2015 AND season_type = 'POST' AND 'CLE' IN (home_team, away_team)

questions.question: Who won Super Bowl LX, and what was the score?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN home_team ELSE away_team END AS winner FROM games WHERE season = 2025 AND playoff_round = 'super_bowl'

questions.question: Which team had the most rushing yards in the 2025 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT team FROM player_game WHERE season = 2025 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'rusher' GROUP BY team ORDER BY sum(yards) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which team had the best third-down conversion rate in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT team FROM team_game WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' GROUP BY team ORDER BY sum(third_down_conversions) / sum(third_down_attempts) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fourth-down conversions did the Eagles have in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(fourth_down_conversions) FROM team_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND team = 'PHI'

questions.question: In how many 2023 regular season games did the Bills average more than 0.2 EPA per designed play?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM team_game WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND team = 'BUF' AND epa_per_play > 0.2

questions.question: Which team's offense threw the most interceptions in the 2018 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT team FROM team_game WHERE season = 2018 AND season_type = 'REG' GROUP BY team ORDER BY sum(interceptions) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fumbles did the Giants lose in the 2019 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(fumbles_lost) FROM team_game WHERE season = 2019 AND season_type = 'REG' AND team = 'NYG'

questions.question: Which team had the single best offensive game by EPA per designed play in 2020, and against whom?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT team, opponent FROM team_game WHERE season = 2020 ORDER BY epa_per_play DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many offensive drives did the Bengals have in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' AND posteam = 'CIN'

questions.question: What share of drives ended in a punt in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg((drive_result = 'Punt')::INT) FROM drives WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG'

questions.question: Which team scored a touchdown on the highest share of its drives in the 2020 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM drives WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(scored_touchdown::INT) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many drives ended in a turnover on downs in the 2023 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND drive_result = 'Turnover on downs'

questions.question: How many 2022 regular season games were played outdoors?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM games WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND roof = 'outdoors'

questions.question: How many points were scored in the highest-scoring game of the 2015 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT max(total_points) FROM games WHERE season = 2015 AND season_type = 'REG'

questions.question: How many home games did the Packers lose in the 2018 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM games WHERE season = 2018 AND season_type = 'REG' AND home_team = 'GB' AND home_margin < 0

questions.question: Who led the league in rushing yards in the 2016 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season = 2016 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'rusher' GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY sum(yards) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many receiving touchdowns did Tyreek Hill have in the 2020 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(touchdowns) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'receiver' AND full_name = 'Tyreek Hill'

questions.question: Which quarterback threw for the most yards in a single game in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'passer' ORDER BY yards DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many games with at least 100 receiving yards did Justin Jefferson have in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'receiver' AND full_name = 'Justin Jefferson' AND yards >= 100

questions.question: How many passes did Joe Burrow complete in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(completions) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'passer' AND full_name = 'Joe Burrow'

questions.question: How many sacks did the Steelers' defense record in the 2019 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(sack::INT) FROM plays WHERE season = 2019 AND season_type = 'REG' AND defteam = 'PIT'

questions.question: What was the Raiders' average air yards per pass attempt in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(air_yards) FROM plays WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' AND posteam = 'LV' AND air_yards IS NOT NULL

questions.question: How many punts were there in the 2023 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND punt_attempt = 1

questions.question: What position does Travis Kelce play?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT position FROM players WHERE full_name = 'Travis Kelce'

questions.question: How many plays with the Cowboys on offense drew a penalty in the 2023 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND posteam = 'DAL' AND penalty

questions.question: Which team averaged the most air yards per pass in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND air_yards IS NOT NULL GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(air_yards) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How long was the longest made field goal of the 2019 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT max(kick_distance) FROM plays WHERE season = 2019 AND season_type = 'REG' AND field_goal_result = 'made'

questions.question: How many sacks did the Steelers defense record in the 2020 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' AND defteam = 'PIT' AND sack

questions.question: Which team threw the most interceptions in the 2012 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2012 AND season_type = 'REG' AND interception GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which team had the highest pass rate over expected in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' AND is_designed_play GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(pass_oe) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many two-point conversions did the Eagles attempt in the 2024 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2024 AND season_type = 'REG' AND posteam = 'PHI' AND two_point_attempt

questions.question: How many times did Lamar Jackson scramble in the 2023 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG' AND qb_scramble AND rusher_player_name = 'L.Jackson' AND posteam = 'BAL'

questions.question: How many regular-season games went to overtime in 2022?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT game_id) FROM plays WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND game_half = 'Overtime'

questions.question: Who gained the most yards after the catch in the 2020 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT receiver_player_name FROM plays WHERE season = 2020 AND season_type = 'REG' AND yards_after_catch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY receiver_player_id, receiver_player_name ORDER BY sum(yards_after_catch) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fumbles did the Giants lose in the 2021 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2021 AND season_type = 'REG' AND posteam = 'NYG' AND fumble_lost

questions.question: How many rushing yards did the Bears have in the 2022 regular season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT sum(yards) FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND season_type = 'REG' AND role = 'rusher' AND team = 'CHI'

questions.question: Who won Super Bowl LVII?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN home_margin > 0 THEN home_team ELSE away_team END AS winner FROM games WHERE season = 2022 AND playoff_round = 'super_bowl'
